subject: [PATCH 1/2] scsi: mpi3mr: Poll a reply queue that an interrupt found busy

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch addresses a situation where an interrupt handler for the MPI3MR SCSI device returns without processing a reply queue, leaving it busy and unprocessed until the next interrupt or command timeout. To fix this, the patch sets a flag to enable polling of the reply queue when it is found busy, allowing the IRQ thread to process any pending replies.
